restaurantName: The River Restaurant at The Lowry Hotel
address: 50 Dearmans Pl, Chapel Wharf, Salford, Manchester,M3 5LH
bio: Enjoy a sumptuous Afternoon Tea at The River Restaurant. Located inside the Lowry Hotel, with iconic river views overlooking Santiago Calatrava's Trinity Bridge.  The convivial atmosphere is also deeply luxurious with purple leather chairs, semi-circular banquettes, while Fornasetti plates, mirrors and lithographs and prints decorate walls.  The Afternoon Tea menu has been devised around the best local and seasonal produce. Elegant finger sandwiches. Scones with fresh cream and a dollop of strawberry jam. Decadent pastries and dainty fancies. And tea, as much as you can drink. Or a glass or two of Champagne. For an indulgence with a twist, upgrade to an Afternoon Tea G & T or cocktails.  The Lowry Hotel is nestled in Manchester by the River Irwell, just a short walk from Salford Central station.
pageTitle: The River Restaurant at The Lowry Hotel
